name: Reference Analyst Skill
purpose: Analyses user-supplied reference videos into reusable motion-design knowledge: ingests and measures them with scripts/reference-corpus.py, inspects the evidence, writes reference-source and technique records with observation separate from interpretation, capability classes, provenance and rights, and maintains the capability backlog.
capabilities: Reference ingest, automated analysis and evidence inspection workflow
Source records: concept, aspects, scenes, moments, brand-asset exclusions, uncertainties
Technique records: mechanics, parameters, failure modes, capability class, provenance, validation evidence
Duplicate detection before new records; backlog reporting; brief recommendations

installation.instructions: Built-in workspace skill. Analysis needs the decoders described in tool-reference-corpus.

compatibility.notes: Used on the Windows dev host for the first 14-video corpus (2026-10-30).

licensing.notes: Internal workspace-owned agent skill. Governs third-party reference material as inspiration-only.

security.notes: Writes catalogue records only; reference videos and the analysis cache stay outside tracked folders.

approval_evidence: Applied to 14 reference videos (14 source records, 42 technique records) on 2026-10-30; knowledge base validated by motion-catalogue.py validate and tests/test-reference-corpus.py.
